import ctypes
import os

# Load the GSL libraries
ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so')

# Define the result structure
class GSLResult(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [('val', ctypes.c_double), ('err', ctypes.c_double)]

# Define the function
def compute_bessel_jl(l, x):
    result = GSLResult()
    status = gsl.gsl_sf_bessel_jl_e(ctypes.c_int(l), ctypes.c_double(x), ctypes.byref(result))
    if status != 0:
        raise RuntimeError(f'GSL error with status code {status}')
    return result.val

    assert abs(compute_bessel_jl(2, 0.0) - 0.0) < 1e-10, "Test case 3 failed"

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
